name: Valentina Quiñones
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Michigan Ave and Roosevelt
description:
Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 64, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a surveillance specialist out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A dead drop Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A crew member from Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A Tier 4 executive offers Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: As a surveillance specialist, Ilhan Kozlov-Asamoah embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
A child being put in danger as leverage against them

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (78.2%) with South Asian (21.1%) and Sub-Saharan African (0.7%) ancestry. The combination creates warm medium brown skin with subtle golden undertones from the South Asian heritage, grounded by the Latin American base. Facial structure reflects the Latin American majority with some South Asian refinement in cheekbone prominence.
physical_description.build: Stocky and heavily muscled through the shoulders and chest, thick through the core with the weathered density of someone who has spent decades in physical labor and combat. His frame reads as compact power rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with traces of darker brown at the roots
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the scalp, military-neat, showing the shape of his skull
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown, natural. Right eye: cybernetic with amber-tinted optical lens and visible recording aperture.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones from blended Latin American and South Asian heritage, weathered by sun exposure and chemical exposure
physical_description.complexion: Broad-faced with a prominent nose and heavy brow ridge showing Latin American and South Asian features. Deep laugh lines around the eyes and mouth. Visible scarring along the left jawline — pale, old tissue. The right side of his face shows surgical scarring around the eye socket where the replacement was installed. Sparse stubble, graying.
distinguishing_marks: Thin pale scar running from left temple down to the angle of the jaw — approximately 12cm, old injury
Chemical burn scarring across the knuckles of both hands — white and puckered, scattered across the dorsal surfaces
Visible chrome assembly around the right orbital socket — matte gunmetal finish with faint circuit etching
Nasal passages show chrome-plated tubular augmentation around the septum — visible as a thin metallic line when viewed from below
Faded tattoo on left shoulder — anchor wrapped in text, partially obscured by age and scarring
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cybernetic right eye with amber recording lens and zoom capability. Chemical analyzer assembly integrated into nasal passages — visible as subtle chrome detailing around the septum and nasal cavity, particularly noticeable when he inhales deeply. Both modifications show no attempt at concealment or cosmetic smoothing.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the economy of someone who has learned that wasted motion is wasted energy. Shoulders slightly forward, weight on the balls of his feet even when standing still — ready posture. His left hand rests naturally; his right hand often moves to check equipment or weapons. Direct eye contact (prioritizing his organic eye), minimal facial expression until he smiles — then the laugh lines deepen and his entire face changes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working runner aesthetic. Graphite-gray reinforced cargo jacket with visible breakaway panels for gear access. Under-armor thermal compression shirt. Worn dark denim with reinforced thigh pockets for tools and sensors. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and re-heeled multiple times. A paracord bracelet on his left wrist and a worn analog chronograph watch on his right — no smart-devices visible on his person. Everything functional, nothing decorative. Minimal branding; gear chosen for durability over status.
